name: Alabbar Enterprises & ANOTHER
logo_hint: Minimalist 'alabbar' lowercase wordmark, black on transparent; premium/curated feel
brand_notes: Real site is monochrome (black/white) + amber accent #F5A623 in Arial. Deepened the amber to #C8971C for WCAG contrast on off-white, added a warm espresso secondary (#7A4E2D) and a cream bg (#FBF9F5) to bring the F&B/hospitality warmth the portfolio (Karak House, Ganache, Krema) implies. Display swapped to Fraunces (warm high-contrast serif) for an editorial 'moments' voice; Inter for body.
